from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RevenueEntry(BaseModel):
    """One financial revenue figure extracted from a single document."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name associated with this financial report")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the revenue figure corresponds to")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The revenue amount as a numeric value")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the line item found (e.g., 'Total Revenue', 'Total Operating Revenue')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    revenue_entries: list[RevenueEntry]
